name: @agents-inc/skills
description: Skills, stacks, and agents for Agents Inc
author: Vincent Bollaert

scripts.//update-marketplace: The published package is `agents-inc`, not `@agents-inc/cli` — the scoped name this script used to call was never published, so every run failed at npx before reaching a build. The `--name agents-inc` argument is the marketplace name and is unrelated to the package name; they match by coincidence. To run the build against a local CLI checkout instead of the published one, substitute the path to its built entry point for both `npx agents-inc` calls: `node ../cli/packages/cli/dist/index.js build plugins` (adjust the path, and run the CLI's build first — dist is not checked in).
scripts.update-marketplace: npx agents-inc build plugins && npx agents-inc build marketplace --name agents-inc
